items.headline: $KAVA Lend Exploit Drains Millions, Token Crashes 47%
items.summary: Attackers used inflated BUSD collateral to borrow 55.2M $KAVA from Kava Lend. Bridge withdrawals halted and three Korean exchanges suspended transfers as $KAVA plunged 47%.

items.headline: $AAVE Sees $39M in Liquidations Amid Market Rout
items.summary: Aave executive Luigi D'Onorio DeMeo reported ~$18M in liquidations in one day and $21M more the next as the crypto selloff hammered $AAVE borrowers.

items.headline: Mystery 1.78M $SOL Stake Withdrawal Sparks Treasury Drama
items.summary: Trackers linked 1.78M $SOL (~$123M) in stake withdrawals to Forward Industries, but the treasury company denies ownership. Onchain data confirms the moves — the whale remains disputed.

items.headline: $DOT Bets Big on Messaging App and Native Stablecoin
items.summary: Polkadot is leaning into a new messaging app and a $DOT-backed stablecoin initiative, aiming to revive ecosystem momentum with fresh consumer and DeFi use cases.

items.headline: Telegram Bot Widget Ban Rattles $TON Mini-App Scene
items.summary: Telegram restricted general bots from sending HTML widgets amid a security dispute, a blow to the $TON ecosystem's mini-app and bot-driven DeFi tooling.
